create_LoggingWorker: create a LoggingWorker instance with custom timeout, max queue size, and concurrency settings
start_LoggingWorker: start the LoggingWorker background coroutine processor to begin processing queued tasks
enqueue_LoggingWorker: enqueue an async coroutine into the LoggingWorker queue for background processing
stop_LoggingWorker: stop the LoggingWorker and cancel all running and pending tasks
flush_LoggingWorker: flush all remaining queued coroutines in the LoggingWorker before shutdown
